So I wanted to give a brief rundown of exactly what it is and how it relates to development in the city. Chapter 16 of our code sets out some provisions that in large part are based upon state law that's been in place for a long time. And that state law provides that landowners are and can be responsible for the payment for improvements of infrastructure and streets abutting their properties. And so you'll see a lot of development projects come forward where funds are being paid or deferred for current development. Well, if we have, usually streets are going to follow development a lot, but sometimes there's going to be a few straggling parcels that don't develop as quickly. So it's based on the cost of acquiring the land as well as the construction of the streets and our infrastructure. And so it relates to Chapter 19 of our code, which addresses development and what exactly that is.
